import sys

def func(x, n):
    return -n * (n * n - 3 * n - 3 * x * x + 9 * x - 4) / (2 * (x - 2) * (x - 1) * x)

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    tokens = line.split()
    x = int(tokens[0].strip())
    p = float(tokens[1].strip())
    ans = 0
    for i in range(x + 1):
        if func(x, i) >= p:
            ans = i
            break
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
